title: Nucleic Acid Purification Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map: place six patient‑sample racks (each holding a full set of 15 samples), a custom 10 mL tube rack, a NEST 96‑well plate (2 mL wells), and the Opentrons Temperature Module (GEN2). In the extraction plate leave wells A1, B1, H1, A7, B7, and H7 empty. The protocol will later transfer 100 µL of each sample to the remaining wells.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all labware, the tip rack (Opentrons 1000 µL filter tips), and the P1000‑single‑channel electronic pipette (GEN2) with the recommended calibration tips.
